personality: Fusion of 6 Glass / Luxe DARK structure with 7 Dark-First Utility metrics & neon accents
personality_one_liner: A cinematic, ultra-premium dark mode barter exchange that feels like a high-end fintech command center rather than a social app.

spacing.rule: Use 4px base unit. Cards have 20px padding. Generous vertical breathing room. Whitespace carries the premium feel.

do's: Use blur extensively on bottom tab bar, sticky headers, and Match sheet backgrounds.
Use heavy tint (>75% surface) under the blur to ensure text readability.
Apply glass effects on floating action buttons (FABs) and premium callouts.
dont's: Never blur body text regions or form fields.
Avoid applying blur on dense data metrics.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The user requested font weights of 700/800. Our system rules STRICTLY FORBID specifying weights over 500 (`Never specify 600, 700, 800`). You MUST use weight `500` max and rely on the display font ('Space Grotesk' or similar) and large sizing to achieve the heavy, bold impact the user wants. Do not use 700/800 in code.
Implement a strict dark theme (CRED-style). Base background is always `#0A0A0A`, cards are `#1C1C1C`. Never use white backgrounds.
The primary action button should use `#FF6B35` with `#0A0A0A` text for maximum contrast and punch.
Shadows should be dark and deep. Use `rgba(0,0,0,0.4)` for card dropshadows and a subtle `rgba(255,107,53,0.15)` glow around primary orange elements.
The AI Match Modal should be implemented as a bottom sheet (`@gorhom/bottom-sheet`) with a blur backdrop. It must be thumb-accessible, swipe-to-close, with 'Message Now' as the prominent action.
Copy should be conversational Hinglish (e.g., 'Main tera logo design karunga, tu mera tax bharda'). Integrate this naturally in empty states and onboarding.

Any text overlaid on background images (e.g., Onboarding, SwapKaro Pro) MUST have a 3-stop top-to-bottom vertical gradient scrim ranging from transparent to at least 75% surfaceInverse/black to ensure absolute text readability.
